standing: Derived read model, not authority. Written by `node scripts/check-evidence-mirrors.mjs --write` from the tenant directory; `npm run lint:evidence` refuses a mirror root absent from it or holding more tracked paths than it lists, and a tracked path over the size bound it does not list under oversize with the same byte count. It is the reference inventory TD-19 requires before any historical deletion; it authorizes none.

rules.root: Each tracked path under .ai-workspace/ except a .diff or .patch (an authored patch, never classified) is classified by the first segment below .ai-workspace/ that opens a copied tree by name (markers other than contracts); a path no such segment classifies is classified by its first contracts directory that holds, at the same index, at least one tracked path naming by its position below that directory a tracked path below build_tenants/abiogenesis/typescript/contracts/ (a contracts directory naming none is a run's own output). The mirror root is the path above the marker. `paths` and `bytes` count the classified paths of the root (logical blob bytes from git cat-file --batch-check, duplicates counted).
rules.kind: In this order. uat-run-source: work/T287_SANDBOX_UAT_RUN_02/operator/<run>/source. contracts-tree: the only marker is contracts (classified by content). ignore-skeleton: every classified path is a .gitignore (the per-directory ignore files of a copied tree whose listed files stay untracked). sandbox-worksite: the root path has a segment sandbox, worksite, worksite-result, supplied-work, unit-runs or workspace (a sandbox's or a harness run's own worksite). install: only node_modules paths, or a segment node_modules, package, installed, extracted, bootstrap or install below the owner. build-output: a segment build, build-<n>, baseline-build, compiled, compiled-<n>, emitted or dist below the owner. repository-tree: a build_tenants or nested .ai-workspace marker. unclassified: pathsAtHead and pathsDuplicated both 0. repository-tree: a specification marker. tenant-tree: otherwise.
rules.pathsAtHead: Classified paths whose position below the root (under build_tenants/abiogenesis/typescript/ for a tenant marker or contracts) is a tracked path at this index; names only, not bytes.
rules.pathsDuplicated: Classified paths whose blob is also tracked at a path outside the root.
rules.cut: The first commit (a 40-hex run, or a 7-12-hex run with a letter on a line naming a commit, head, cut, basis or base, verified as a commit object) in freeze.json, source-manifest.json, basis.json, L2-candidate-freeze*.json, report.md or return.md directly in the root's parent directory, then in each ancestor up to the owner; null with cutLookedIn (every file examined) otherwise. The commit is the one the record names, not proved to be the copied tree: cut.pathsMatching counts the classified paths whose blob equals the blob at the same position (under build_tenants/abiogenesis/typescript/ for a tenant marker) in that commit's build_tenants/ and specification/ trees (under build_tenants/abiogenesis/typescript/ for a tenant marker or contracts).
rules.references: Tracked text files (.md, .json, .jsonl, .py, .mjs, .js, .ts, .sh, .txt, .yaml, .yml, .toml) under .ai-workspace/ or build_tenants/abiogenesis/typescript/ outside the root's marked trees whose text names a path inside the root. Candidates: the files one git grep --cached -l -F finds for any owner's directory name followed by a slash, and the text files outside every mirror below any root's parent directory. Each path-like token is resolved from its first .ai-workspace segment when it starts there or is absolute; else through the owner's name it contains (with the preceding segment when two owners share the name); else against the file's directory (a token that starts with a marker names a live repository path and is skipped). It is attributed to the deepest root containing the resolved path. A bare token equal to a root's last segment names that root when it is the root against the file's directory (a path join). Excluded: this inventory and .ai-workspace/work/T290_DEBT_WAVE_01/. referencesOutsideMirrors counts the references not themselves inside a mirror root.
rules.oversize: Every tracked path in the repository whose blob exceeds 6000000 bytes, with its bytes and readers. Nothing over the bound enters: the check refuses a tracked path over it that this list does not hold at the same byte count. readers: the tracked text files (formats and areas as for references, other than the path itself) whose text names the path, found in the same pass: the reference candidates, plus the text files outside every mirror below the path's parent directory, plus, for a path outside .ai-workspace/, the files naming its file name. A path-like token names it when the token, resolved from its .ai-workspace or build_tenants segment (absolute tokens), through an owner's name, against the file's directory, from a file outside every mirror as a repository path, or from a tenant file as a tenant path, is the path; a bare file name names it when it is the path against the file's directory.
